name: s10-cpp-enum-forms
description: The forms of C/C++ enum declarations: unscoped enums (enumerators also in the enclosing scope), enum class / enum struct with underlying types and character literals, C style typedef enums (anonymous and tagged), enums in nested namespaces and in classes, an enum defined out of line after its opaque declaration, an opaque enum without definition (values by cast), negative values; comparisons (== and the order of values of the same enum class), unscoped enums in integer arithmetic, enum typed events, out events and operations; the values as enumerator names.
text: A -> B : pick [valueof(pick) != ::Red] / color = valueof(pick); led = ::LED_ON; dir = motor_dir_t::DIR_RIGHT; sensorState = app::Sensor::Busy; unit = select(unit); phase = app::Phase::Run; hnd = 7 as app::Handle; flags = ::kHex | color; key = Key::A; raise changed : app::Sensor::Kind::Temperature

B -> A : level [valueof(level) > app::io::Level::Mid || valueof(level) < app::io::Level::Mid] / lv = valueof(level); high = lv >= app::io::Level::High && color == Color::Blue; flags = flags + ::kLow + (hnd as integer)

enums.h: enum Color { Red, Green = 2, Blue, /**< blue light */ };
enum struct Key : std::uint8_t { Enter = '\n', Space = ' ', A = 'a' };
typedef enum motor_dir_tag { DIR_LEFT, DIR_RIGHT } motor_dir_t;
enum class Level : std::int8_t { Low = -1, Mid = 0, High = 1 };
enum class Kind : std::uint16_t { Temperature = 100, Pressure };
enum class Sensor::Unit : std::uint8_t { Celsius, Bar };
enum class Phase : int { Init, Run };
